name: Helicone
tagline: MCP-Native Agent Eval vs API Gateway Observability
oneLine: Open-source LLM observability platform and AI gateway; acquired by Mintlify on March 3, 2026 and now running in maintenance mode.
tldrVendor: Helicone is an open-source, proxy-based AI gateway and observability platform with cost analytics by custom property, response caching, and routing across 100+ models; acquired by Mintlify in March 2026, it now runs in maintenance mode. If you need per-property cost analytics, response caching, or a unified gateway across many LLM providers, Helicone covers that ground.

rows.quote: Use the familiar OpenAI SDK to access 100+ LLM models across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and more with automatic logging, observability, and fallbacks built in.

rows.vendor: All-in-one Docker image (web, API, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, MinIO); Helm chart for Kubernetes
rows.quote: To run all services in a single Docker container, you can use the helicone-all-in-one image.

rows.vendor: Rust AI gateway; vendor-reported P95 latency under 5 ms
No built-in evaluators; accepts scores from external eval frameworks via API or the dashboard
rows.quote: Helicone doesn't run evaluations for you - we're not an evaluation framework.

rows.vendor: Cost per user, conversation, feature or environment via custom properties
rows.quote: Calculate cost per user, conversation, or feature to understand your application's profitability

rows.vendor: MCP server for data access only
rows.quote: debug errors, search logs, analyze performance, and examine request/response bodies without leaving your AI assistant

rows.vendor: Acquired by Mintlify (Mar 3, 2026); product in maintenance mode; last changelog entry Nov 26, 2025
rows.quote: Helicone has been acquired by Mintlify, and our team will be joining them in San Francisco.

rows.vendor: Dashboard with Requests, Sessions, Users, Segments and HQL query views
rows.quote: The world's fastest-growing AI companies rely on Helicone to route, debug, and analyze their applications.

rows.vendor: Gateway integrations for LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Vercel AI SDK, Zapier, Codex
rows.quote: Integrate Helicone AI Gateway with popular frameworks and tools to access 100+ LLM providers with top tier observability

rows.vendor: Versioned prompts with rollback and per-environment deployment via the AI Gateway
rows.quote: Track every change, compare versions, and rollback instantly if something goes wrong

rows.vendor: SOC 2 Type II + HIPAA (Team and Enterprise), GDPR via EU region, SAML SSO, on-prem, Helm chart
Hobby free (10,000 requests a month, 1 GB storage, 1 seat); Pro $79/month; Team $799/month; usage-based pricing applies; Enterprise custom
rows.quote: 10,000 free requests 1 GB storage 1 seat, 1 organization

vendorReasons.text: You need cost analytics — per-user, per-conversation, per-feature spend breakdowns via custom properties
You want response caching to avoid repeat charges on identical requests
You need a full AI gateway with retries, fallbacks, and rate limiting
You need enterprise compliance today (SOC 2, GDPR)
You want a unified gateway across 100+ models and 20+ LLM providers

faq.question: What is the difference between Iris and Helicone?
faq.vendorPart: Helicone is an open-source, proxy-based AI gateway and observability platform with cost analytics by custom property, response caching, and routing across 100+ models; it was acquired by Mintlify in March 2026 and is in maintenance mode. Helicone offers cost breakdowns and gateway features, and does not run evaluations itself.

faq.question: Is Iris better than Helicone for MCP agent evaluation?
faq.vendorPart: Helicone uses a proxy-based approach (a Rust gateway with vendor-reported P95 latency under 5 ms) and offers response caching, rate limiting, fallbacks, and cost analytics by custom property; it does not run evaluations itself.

sources.label: Helicone blog: Helicone is joining Mintlify (2026-03-03)
